name: Windy City Wire
old_description: Windy City Wire - Low-Voltage Cable Manufacturer and Cable Management Specialists
about:
Windy City Wire operates from Tempe, Arizona, where it has built a business around low-voltage cable manufacturing and cable management solutions. The company describes its history as spanning more than 30 years, though a specific founding year is not disclosed. Ownership details and founder names have not been made public.

The company produces American-made SmartWire cables, which include value-added features such as FastFIND footage markers and SmartWire Glide lubrication. Its patented RackPack system uses a reel-in-the-box design to streamline cable pulls, reduce waste, and improve jobsite safety. Complementary products include RackPack Transporters for mobility, SmartFIBER enclosures for fiber handoffs, and the SmartKITS platform for configuring custom cable kits. The firm also offers DAS/BDA quoting support and online calculators for conduit fill and voltage drop.

Windy City Wire serves security integrators, low-voltage contractors, and procurement teams working on public safety BDA/DAS systems, CCTV and IP camera networks, and general structured cabling projects. Customer testimonials cite labor savings on large-scale installations, with users from firms such as Automated Life Inc, Komar Associates, and Eire Electric reporting faster pulls and reduced setup time.

The company emphasizes that its integrated RackPack Field System lowers total installed cost by cutting labor hours and simplifying logistics. Custom branding on RackPack cartons allows contractors to promote their own identity on the job site, while the SmartKITS tool lets teams create, share, and reorder tailored kits without re-engineering each project.

name: Winona Foods
old_description: Leading programs from a mission-focused community: To provide our industry and customers exceptional solutions & experiences
about:
Winona Foods, based in Howard, Wisconsin, traces its roots to 1995 when its managing partners, drawing on experience at family-owned cheese companies, established the business. The company began full operations at a new Howard facility in January 2018, which houses a commercial kitchen, product performance center, conversion and distribution center, cooler distribution center, and direct rail access.

The company manufactures a range of cheese products including natural, specialty, imitation, vegan, Italian, and performance cheeses, and performs conversion operations such as shredding, slicing, cubing, dicing, and chunking. It also provides co-packing services, industrial ingredients, and supplies the food service and retail segments. With manufacturing distribution centers strategically located across the United States, Winona Foods handles development, manufacturing, packaging, storage, and delivery.

Winona Foods serves dairy manufacturers, industrial ingredient buyers, food service operators, retail chains, and co-packing clients. Its direct sales force and national broker network reach customers across the food industry.

The company states its mission is to be the industry leader by providing exceptional solutions, service, quality, and value, emphasizing a dedication to the highest quality portfolio and exceeding industry standards.

name: Wire Winders Inc
old_description: components/parts that meet your individual requirements, look no further
about:
Wire Winders Inc. was established in 1991 in Milford, New Hampshire, by a group of coil winding experts who collectively brought more than 60 years of industry experience. The company operates from a facility on Mont Vernon Road in Milford and has remained focused on custom magnetic components since its inception.

The firm specializes in custom wound magnetic devices and assemblies of varying type and size, offering services from prototype through full production runs. Its core capability is custom coil winding, taking customer ideas, drawings, or specifications from concept to finished product with advanced technical and manufacturing expertise.

Wire Winders serves a broad range of sectors, including aerospace, scientific research, medical, audio, printing, military, academic, semiconductor, communications, transportation, and general manufacturing.

The company’s guiding principle, “Where the Unusual is Commonplace,” reflects its focus on solving non‑standard winding challenges. It emphasizes design optimization, customized service matching individual specifications, and a commitment to responsive attention and uncompromising quality.

name: WireNut Home Services
old_description: Enriching Lives Through Exceptional Service in Colorado Since 2004
about:
WireNut Home Services is based in Colorado Springs, Colorado, and has operated since 2004. The company provides electrical, heating, cooling, plumbing, and drain-clearing services to residential customers across Southern Colorado, including the Denver metro area, Pueblo County, and Boulder County. Ownership structure and founder names are not disclosed in the source material.

The business fields a team of licensed technicians with over 200 years of combined experience across HVAC, plumbing, and electrical trades. It reports more than 65,000 customer reviews and serves a broad footprint that spans Colorado Springs neighborhoods such as Briargate, Cimarron Hills, and Flying Horse, as well as communities in Boulder, Castle Rock, Denver, and Pueblo. Services range from emergency electrical repairs and air-conditioner diagnostics to furnace part replacement and drain clearing.

The customer base consists almost entirely of homeowners seeking same-day or scheduled maintenance, repair, and installation work. The company highlights residential HVAC, plumbing, and electrical systems as its core focus, with no indication of commercial or industrial contracts in the provided content.

WireNut emphasizes a "No Surprises Promise" that includes upfront pricing, 30-minute arrival notices, background-checked technicians, and same-day repairs when requested by 2 p.m. A lifetime workmanship warranty covers installation quality, and a risk-free guarantee offers repair or refund if an installed product underperforms in its first year. Financing is available through a Greensky partnership.

name: Wiringproducts, Ltd.
old_description: Wiring Products was founded in 2004 with the goal of providing excellent quality 12 volt and automotive electrical parts supplies at competitive prices, with many of our products manufactured right here in the USA.
about:
Wiring Products was founded in 2004 in Sparks, Nevada, as a family-owned business focused on supplying 12-volt and automotive electrical parts. The company began with the goal of offering quality components at competitive prices, with an emphasis on domestic manufacturing.

The company produces a broad line of automotive electrical supplies, including automotive wire, battery cable, circuit breakers, copper lugs and eyelets, fuse holders and fuses, heat shrink tubing, molded trailer connectors, flashers and solenoids, and wire terminals. Many of these products are manufactured at its U.S. facility, though the company does not disclose facility size, headcount, or production volumes.

Wiring Products serves the automotive, marine, solar, RV and trailer, commercial, and industrial sectors. Its customer base includes both retail and wholesale buyers seeking electrical components for vehicle and equipment wiring, though specific client names are not public.

The business distinguishes itself through its commitment to U.S.-based manufacturing for a significant portion of its catalog, combined with a focus on product quality and competitive pricing. The family-run operation also highlights knowledgeable customer service as a core value.

name: Wisconsin Furniture LLC
old_description: Incorporating modern styles and lines, these tables are designed to mesh seamlessly with new home construction, renovations, or contemporary tones
about:
Wisconsin Furniture LLC operates from Pardeeville, Wisconsin, where it designs and builds custom tables for residential and commercial spaces. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, but its focus on handcrafted production suggests a small-scale, artisan-oriented operation.

The shop produces modern and rustic tables, each made to order in any dimension a customer requires. Using hand-fabrication techniques, the team can replicate or combine design elements sourced from inspiration platforms such as Pinterest or Wayfair, and they also accommodate unique requests such as tables built around existing chairs. Collaboration occurs via email, phone, or traditional mail, allowing for a highly personalized design process.

Primary customers include homeowners undertaking new construction or renovations, as well as interior designers seeking bespoke pieces. The company's tables have been described by clients as conversation centerpieces in entertainment spaces, indicating a focus on high-visibility, heirloom-quality furniture for living and dining areas.

Wisconsin Furniture states its mission is to create high-quality, heirloom furniture that will be enjoyed for generations, emphasizing that all products are proudly made in the United States. This commitment to domestic manufacturing and generational durability serves as the core differentiator in a market often dominated by mass-produced imports.

name: Wisconsin Log Furniture and Railings
old_description: We are a small, family run business that builds and supplies custom rustic furniture and log railings that are certain to last for years to come.
about:
Wisconsin Log Furniture and Railings operates from Wausaukee, Wisconsin. The business traces its roots to 2014 when the founder built a log chaise lounge chair, sparking a passion for rustic woodworking. The current name was adopted in 2019, and the company remains a family-owned operation.

The shop produces custom rustic furniture and log railings, all handmade from locally sourced white cedar, aspen, hickory, and barnwood. Offerings include indoor and outdoor furniture collections, cedar log railings with options such as metal spindles, rustic metal panels, and stainless-steel cable, as well as white cedar shutters. Each piece is built to order in a Northeast Wisconsin workshop, with no two items identical due to the natural character of the logs.

Customers span the United States, including homeowners furnishing cabins and primary residences, hospitality operators outfitting Airbnb and vacation rental properties, and commercial clients seeking rustic fixtures for lodges and retail spaces. The Durango Bedroom Collection, blending aspen and barnwood, is marketed directly to these segments.

The company emphasizes sustainably harvested white cedar obtained from local foresters within hours of the shop. A craftsmanship guarantee promises continued collaboration until the client is satisfied, reflecting the founder's original goal of creating unique, durable pieces that last for years.

name: Wisconsin Plastics Inc
old_description: Contract manufacturing in plastics involves design, prototyping, production, and assembly of plastic components for various industries. WPI specializes in custom solutions.
about:
Wisconsin Plastics Inc (WPI) is headquartered in Green Bay, Wisconsin. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure in the provided materials. It describes itself as an "idea company" that turns concepts into custom-manufactured products through collaboration with customers and a network of capabilities.

WPI operates as a contract manufacturer specializing in scientific molding, electromechanical assembly, and integrated product design. Its service portfolio spans project management, product design, scientific molding, electromechanical assemblies, integrated technology, distribution and fulfillment, and contract manufacturing. The company also designs and fabricates automated assembly fixtures, performs clean-room and electronic assembly, and offers UL-approved assembly, soldering, and testing. It sources and warehouses externally manufactured components and provides direct shipping via FedEx, UPS, LTL, and full-load carriers with full EDI capabilities.

The company serves defense and aerospace, medical, automotive, retail, and industrial sectors. It highlights cutting-edge design and quality procedures for demanding defense and aerospace environments, and produces sterile, biocompatible components for medical devices.

WPI emphasizes a value-based approach that aims to deliver better communication, lower costs, and shorter lead times by taking projects from consumer research through production implementation. It maintains a sustainability program that includes using regrind, recycling, energy-efficient hybrid molding machines, closed-loop water systems, and membership in the EPA's Green Supplier Network.
